observations: Photo 0 shows a black console with 'XBOX' logo on top, wrapped in plastic, with two black controllers in front.
Photo 1 shows the side of the same console, with a perforated vent and a blue light reflection; a cardboard box labeled 'CFI-2116 A01Y' is visible in the background.
Photo 2 shows the console from another angle, still wrapped, with the 'XBOX' logo visible; controllers are in front.
All three photos show the console and controllers in a cluttered storage environment with cardboard boxes and plastic wrap.
The console appears to be an Xbox One X based on size, shape, and logo, but no model number is visible on the console itself.
The controllers appear to be standard Xbox One controllers, with no visible damage or wear.
The console is still in plastic wrapping, suggesting it may be new or recently unboxed.

identity.kind: Xbox One X console with two controllers
